confidence_policy: Do not transfer or recalibrate baseline scores. New proposals require new independent review.
comparison_policy: Development regression only; source/control/candidate identities and membership preserved. Proposal suppression is not measured precision and cannot establish recall.
uncertainty_policy: Partial coverage, unsupported formats, historical schema/venue/plan authority, dividend baselines, first disclosure, public timing and final action identity remain unresolved without evidence.
ownership_policy: Reuse frozen ownership parser; no expanded schema authority.
changes: Carry paragraph, section, table and definition roles through extraction
Exclude performance/compensation sections from event evidence
Extract narrative footnotes without guessing numeric table-column associations
Require finite actor/action/object and retain negative/modal contexts
Separate reported announcement, approval, declaration and public-time fields
Retain multiple-distribution dates explicitly instead of choosing the first
Preserve parent filing genre and contextual action identity
Do not merge identical wording at distinct source locations
Retain scheduled payable dates separately from dates reported as paid
